label: Greenfield (new build)
blurb: Greenfield: heavy upstream framing, specification and design. Novel, creative work — the least automatable stage.

label: Feature add (active development)
blurb: Feature-heavy full SDLC, implementation and verification dominate. Baseline automatability.

label: Maintenance (stabilised)
blurb: Stabilised product: validation, deployment and run rise, new build falls. Repeatable work, more automatable.

label: Modernisation (legacy)
blurb: Mostly run and support, minimal new change. Routine, highly automatable work.

label: End-of-life (→ maintenance)
blurb: Decommissioning, migration and archiving dominate. Mechanical work, well automatable.
